IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'StagingScoreItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem]( [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [MetricAssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Result] [bit] NOT NULL, [Processing] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Processing] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [Archived] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Archived] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricStagingScoreItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Archived] DESC, [AssetUid] ASC, [MetricAssetUid] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricStagingScoreItem_Asset_Metric_Date_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MetricStagingScoreItem_Asset_Metric_Date_Include] ON [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ( [AssetUid] ASC, [MetricAssetUid] ASC, [EffectiveDate] ASC ) INCLUDE([Result]) END
